name: Broad validation (full Vitest suite, Linux container)
description: Build artifacts then run the full Vitest suite in a Linux container. The suite is container-equivalent: OS-specific code (Windows registry, scheduled tasks, .lnk shortcuts, VS Code/APPDATA paths) is tested through injected platform/execFile params and tmpdir-scoped env, not real syscalls, so the full suite passes on Linux once dist/ and src/dashboard-ui/routeTree.gen.ts are generated by the build. Retain the actual Vitest Test Files and Tests summary from each live dispatch; static historical counts are not evidence for a new branch. Install uses npm install (NOT npm ci) and skips the optional ONNX Runtime CUDA payload, matching the CI environment — see the install command note.

execution.networkJustification: npm install requires the public npm registry to install dependencies; node_modules is not pre-staged. No other network access is needed once install completes.

commands.name: install
commands.note: npm install, NOT npm ci: the committed package-lock.json is generated on the Windows dev machine and, per npm's cross-platform optional-dependency handling, omits the Linux ideal-tree entries for electron-builder's optional electron-builder-squirrel-windows subtree (app-builder-lib, @electron/*, etc.). npm ci hard-fails on Linux with 'Missing ... from lock file'; a lock regenerated on Linux would then fail npm ci on Windows (it drops the Windows-only entries). npm install reconciles per-platform without a frozen lock. ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL=skip matches the CI environment and skips only the optional CUDA provider download; the CPU runtime used by the test lane remains packaged. The squirrel-windows subtree is only used for Windows installer packaging (electron-builder), never by this build/typecheck/test lane. A new live run must record its actual Vitest Test Files and Tests summaries; do not inherit a historical count.

commands.name: typecheck
commands.run: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:ui

liveExecution.approvalReason: Project owner approved the live VPS Docker run with bridge networking for npm install.

forbidden: Do not run GUI, MSI, installer, or registry-mutating validation in this lane
Do not access network beyond the npm registry during npm install
